ValidationRule.description: Once the Corporate Scheme Case is Closed, only Sales Solutions is able to reopen the Cases
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( RecordTypeId = "01290000001Ybqs", /*Corporate Scheme Service Request*/ ISPICKVAL ( PRIORVALUE ( Status ), "Closed - Completed"), ISCHANGED ( Status ), NOT ( $User.Id = "00590000004hkf4"), NOT ( $User.Id = "00590000004hkfG"), NOT ( $User.ProfileId = "00e90000001wK8z")
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please contact the Sales Solutions Team if you would like to reopen the Corporate Scheme Case
